chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked him about a man washing his wife. He said: Yes. It is only her family that prevents her out of partisanship.

key_terms.تَعَصُّبًا: out of partisanship or tribal bias
key_terms.يُغَسِّلُ: to perform the ritual washing of the deceased

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a husband to wash his wife after her death in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states the permissibility of a husband washing his wife after death. It also indicates that objection to this practice may come from familial partisanship rather than from a valid legal prohibition.
